Applies to: E40 / E60 / E80 / S7 / S9 lithium series (synthetic doc, not a real service manual).

docs.title: Range Anomaly Troubleshooting
docs.section_path: Range Anomaly Troubleshooting Guide (Qingshu Mobility · Synthetic Knowledge) › 1. Symptom confirmation
docs.content:
【Range Anomaly Troubleshooting Guide (Qingshu Mobility · Synthetic Knowledge) › 1. Symptom confirmation】
1. Confirm with the user how they know the battery was fully charged (App SOC=100% or charger green light).
2. Confirm riding scenario: city only, long hills, two riders, low temperature (<5°C).
3. Record VIN (all Demo VINs start with QS0), OTA version, battery spec, and last deep charge/discharge time.

docs.title: Motor Noise and Speed Limit
docs.section_path: Motor Noise and Speed Limit Handling (Synthetic) › Troubleshooting steps
docs.content:
【Motor Noise and Speed Limit Handling (Synthetic) › Troubleshooting steps】
1. Read fault codes: prioritize `MCU_OC_02` (over-current), `MCU_OT_01` (over-temperature).
2. Check rear wheel for debris wrap, abnormal bearing clearance.
3. Confirm recent water exposure or wading.
4. Verify OTA: some older versions falsely trigger speed limit on steep hills—suggest upgrade to v2.3.1+.

docs.title: Motor Noise and Speed Limit
docs.section_path: Motor Noise and Speed Limit Handling (Synthetic) › Actions
docs.content:
【Motor Noise and Speed Limit Handling (Synthetic) › Actions】
- No fault code: tighten motor harness ground, road test 3 km and retest.
- Over-current code: create parts ticket; warehouse prioritizes same-batch controller/motor.
- When `TAG-safety-hazard` applies, do not close remotely by clearing codes only—schedule offline inspection.

docs.title: Renewal Outreach Red Lines
docs.section_path: Smart Vehicle Connectivity Renewal Outreach Red Lines (Synthetic)
docs.content:
【Smart Vehicle Connectivity Renewal Outreach Red Lines (Synthetic)】
1. Users with tag `TAG-open-complaint` are **forbidden** from auto outbound calls and discount Push.
2. Outreach order: Push → SMS → AI call → human; max 3 combined channel touches per user per day.
3. Non-smart vehicles go to `non_smart` pool—product upgrade guidance only, not counted in renewal rate denominator.
4. Only high intent (`intent_level=high`) may transfer to human.
5. Must `read_ai_outputs` / read shared tags before outreach; do not rely on department-private lists alone.
